summary: Tested Excel export/import (10 entities) and MS Project .mpp import backend + frontend UI flows for MARCEL. All 16 backend tests pass. Frontend Excel toolbar validated on 9 pages. Found and fixed a critical crash on /timesheets (missing ExcelToolbar import). Portfolio Excel import UI end-to-end flow works. MS Project modal opens correctly on /roadmap.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: ExcelToolbar is not defined — component was used at line 1036 but not imported, causing full page crash (Uncaught runtime error) with a blank page for users. FIXED by adding `import ExcelToolbar from '@/components/ExcelToolbar'` at top of file.

action_items: Task description referenced `/programs` for the Programmes page, but the actual route is `/programmes` (see App.js:80). Route is correct and Excel toolbar renders correctly there. No fix needed on frontend; suggest aligning docs.
Consider adding a lint rule (react/jsx-no-undef, already default in CRA) — the Timesheets.jsx missing import was not caught pre-deploy; recommend running `yarn lint` before merges.
critical_code_review_comments: Timesheets.jsx (1073 lines) exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into subcomponents.
Preview response uses `errors: []` list on each row while frontend UI badge label mixes singular/plural inconsistently (`Mise à jours`). Minor l10n polish suggested.

commit_import expects raw field:value dicts (no wrapper) while preview returns rows as `{action, errors, data}`. Frontend must remember to send `row.data`. Consider accepting the wrapper shape on the backend too for symmetry, or document this contract in the router docstring.
seed_data_creation: All test artifacts cleaned up after each test (TEST ROUNDTRIP PROJ, TEST MPP IMPORT, TEST UI IMPORT deleted; capex/opex restored where modified). Tenant Altair now has 10 projects; the task expected 11 but pre-existing state was already 10 real + 1 'Projet Test Template' which appears to be seed data left by a previous iteration — not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes are /api/excel/{entity}/{export|import/preview|import/commit} with entities: projects, programs, teams, resources, milestones, risks, decisions, demands, budget, timesheets. Preview returns rows as `{row_num, action, errors[], data{}}`. Commit expects `{rows: [ {field:value,...} ]}` — send preview_row.data, not the wrapper. Projects response key is `project_id` not `id`. Programmes route is /programmes (French). MS Project .mpp binary sample: /tmp/sample.mpp (OLE signature d0cf11e0, 8 tasks). JVM subprocess is warm after first call. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_excel_msproject_io.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Timesheets.jsx crash — RCA: developer added `<ExcelToolbar entity="timesheets" ... />` inline at line 1036 but forgot to add the corresponding `import ExcelToolbar from '@/components/ExcelToolbar'` at the top of the file. Reproduction: navigate to /timesheets while logged in → whole app shows Uncaught runtime error overlay 'ExcelToolbar is not defined'. Mitigation applied: added the missing import; page now loads and Excel toolbar renders.
